rootName.description: Name of the root in paths, as in root.users[0].name.

defaultExpandDepth.description: Levels open on first render when defaultExpanded is not set. 1 opens the root.

defaultExpanded.description: Open branch paths on first render when uncontrolled.

onExpandedChange.description: Called when branches open or close.

onQueryChange.description: Called as the search text changes.

pageSize.description: Children shown per page in a long array or object.

copyable.description: Shows copy value and copy path actions.

onCopy.description: Called after a copy with { kind: "value" | "path", path, text }.

onSelect.description: Called when a row becomes the current one.

showPath.description: Shows the current row's path under the tree.

maxHeight.description: Height of the scrolling tree area. Numbers are pixels.
